info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Servicing Event History API
info.description: The Servicing Event History API provides access to a comprehensive record of servicing events across multiple channels in the banking domain. This API enables developers to retrieve detailed histories of customer interactions and transactions, allowing for improved insights into customer behavior and service efficiency. Typical use cases include customer support, operational reporting, and service optimization. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their decision-making processes and provide superior service experiences.

get.summary: Retrieve servicing event history across channels.
get.description: Fetch the complete history of servicing events recorded across all communication channels. This endpoint allows developers to access detailed logs of interactions and events, facilitating better analysis and customer service improvements.

requestBody.description: This request is used to retrieve the servicing event history for cross-channel operations. It allows the caller to specify various parameters in the request body to filter and customize the response according to their needs.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the servicing event history.
